text: Hired Square is a recruitment opportunity management system that uses business intelligence.
The project was created by Shariq Naqvi.
The project was based in Toronto, Canada.
The project's funding goal was $105,921.
The funding period for the project was from September 25, 2015, to October 25, 2015.
The project was unsuccessful in reaching its funding goal.
The team at Reason Square aimed to tackle inefficiencies that cost close to $150 billion of the global economy.
The team at Reason Square aims to tackle inefficiencies that result in a loss of close to $150 billion in the global economy.
Talent mismatch occurs when a candidate ideally suited for an organization does not deliver what the employer expected.
Talent mismatch is an opportunity cost that significantly impacts productivity.
LinkedIn quantified the loss in productivity due to talent mismatch at $130 billion.
The research found a strong correlation between the adaptability of talent in a country and the performance of its companies.
Improved talent matching could unlock as much as $130 billion of productivity in 11 studied markets.
